note: Keys the engine writes into field_values that are not boxes on any form: carryforwards to next year, answers the form prints as a Yes/No pair, and K-1/return header data used to build other forms. They are part of the golden model without a box. Anything else not in data/schema is rejected from field_values (src/schema/validate.ts). Inventory of prod rows and the engine source, 2026-10-20.

all.nol.carryover_next_year: NOL carried to the next year (worksheet, not a box)
all.schedD.carryover_next_lt: Long-term capital loss carryover to next year (worksheet)
all.schedD.carryover_next_st: Short-term capital loss carryover to next year (worksheet)
all.schedD.loss_carryover: Capital loss carryover used this year (worksheet)
all.f7203.excess_distribution_gain: Distributions above stock basis, taxed as gain (7203 worksheet result)
all.schedB.L7a_foreign_account: Schedule B 7a answer (the form prints it as a Yes/No pair)
all.meta.owners: Shareholder list used to issue K-1s
all.meta.irs_center: IRS center where the return was filed (K-1 item C)
all.meta.name: Name line
all.dep.L42_amortization: Form 4562 line 42 amortization for this year, all rows (the form prints a row per cost)
